# Facebook Scraper & Automation Agent Instructions

## General Instruction Announcement Rule
Whenever you apply or follow instructions from this file, always print a message at the start:
`Applying instructions file FacebookScraper...`

## CLI Educational & Advanced Capabilities Suggestion Rule
- **Proactive CLI Feature Suggestions**: Before executing major phases or actions, identify advanced GitHub Copilot CLI features that can improve the development flow and provide educational value (e.g. specialized subagents, background task agents, plan mode, research agents, session branching, TDD feedback loops).
- Proactively explain the capability, the relationship between agents/tools, and how the user can observe or interact with it.

## Development Methodology
- **TDD (Test-Driven Development)**: Write unit and integration tests first, verify red/green cycles, and mock external network/browser dependencies.
- **Robust Browser Automation**: Support headless/headful Playwright with anti-detection handling, session cookies, and structured action pipelines.
